priorDecision: PHASE 09ZG CONTROLLED LOA LIVE PATH INSTRUMENTATION DIAGNOSTIC PASS WITH ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED
provenRootCause: The ask-handler.js upstream Philippine-tax domain-boundary check uses the base detector without the pipeline-level 09ZE audit-procedure overlay and rejects the four queries before pipeline.js runs.
chosenRemediation: Extracted the narrow 09ZE audit-procedure overlay pattern list and its ALLOW-composition logic out of pipeline.js into a new shared pure module, services/controlled-loa-audit-procedure-boundary.js, exporting isControlledLoaAuditProcedureBoundaryCandidate() and applyControlledLoaAuditProcedureBoundaryOverlay(). pipeline.js's detectPhilippineTaxBoundary() wrapper now delegates to the shared overlay function instead of holding its own copy of the pattern list. ask-handler.js's upstream boundary check (the exact call site that previously returned DOMAIN_BOUNDARY_REJECT for the four failing queries) now wraps its existing base-detector result through the same shared overlay function before deciding REJECT/CLARIFY/continue. No other logic in either file changed.
architecturalRule: A single shared narrow audit-procedure boundary rule (services/controlled-loa-audit-procedure-boundary.js) is used by both ask-handler.js and pipeline.js. Neither file maintains an independent copy of the pattern list.

upstreamBoundaryBehavior: In ask-handler.js, the existing base detectPhilippineTaxBoundary() call result is passed through applyControlledLoaAuditProcedureBoundaryOverlay() before the REJECT/CLARIFY check. Safe audit-procedure candidates that the base detector would reject now continue into handleControlledRagRoute()/pipeline.js instead of returning DOMAIN_BOUNDARY early. Inputs the shared overlay does not recognize remain rejected exactly as before.
finalGateBehavior: evaluateControlledLoaAskGate() in pipeline.js is unchanged and remains the sole authority for matched/excluded/unrelated classification and for constructing responseType: controlled_loa_answer.
